newsitem.title: USA: Tuscarora sees Q4 hurt by lower shipments.
newsitem.headline: Tuscarora sees Q4 hurt by lower shipments.

text.p: Tuscarora Inc said Friday it expects its fourth quarter to be hurt by lower shipments to a large customer, lower than expected gross profit margins at some manufacturing plants and other factors.
The company said the low gross profit margins are principally at sites recently acquired and at plants newly opened this fiscal year.
It also said shipments to one of its large customers continue to be "substantially" below prior years' levels.
In addition, it said extra selling, administrative and interest expenses resulting from the May 30 purchase of an integrated materials business in Hayward, Calif., will hurt the quarter's net income.
The company said it is concentrating its "best management abilities" to raise profit margins at all facilities to the standards of its older operations.
